summary.text: Cathrynn Brown is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 55 since January 1, 2011, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brown earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Reed College and a J.D. from the University of Idaho.
She previously served as the Eddy County GOP chairwoman.
